a.lede: The AI industry continues to gobble up manufacturing resources that were once dedicated to serving PC, smart device, and gadget makers. Inevitably, the PCB industry has started to feel its effects.
a.title: AI demand triggers massive PCB shortage for PC makers as order books full until 2030

b.lede: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.
b.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
